frozen_engine_contract.interpretation: After a week first reaches +5%, a giveback to <=+4% sets the floor state and zeroes new-trade risk scale. The reduced risk budget can remain binding during the recovery interval.

throttled_weak_week_opportunity_regret.hindsight_warning: These realized outcomes are attribution only; they do not authorize replay selection or sizing.

engineering_interpretation: R5.4 contains a recovery-state allocation defect distinct from blanket leverage. The gain-protection state can suppress new risk even when contemporaneous candidates still carry positive reliability/current-expectancy evidence. A valid R5.5 repair must preserve the weekly protection objective, permit only evidence-conditioned recovery deployment inside the existing portfolio risk envelope, and prove the result in the full 34x15x510 causal replay. No candidate is promoted from this forensic alone.
